text: Send to Many has been such a great addition to our site and for our sales team. The upload feature moved our team away from a tedious manual process to a quick, simple workflow, saving them an incredible amount of time. The front-end experience was easy to set up and highly customizable. Cam has been there every step of the way, helping us get our site experience exactly where we want it. Great partner to work with!

Cam Balzer and the Send To Many team have created an invaluable tool for gifting on the Shopify platform. The onboarding process was incredibly quick and smooth. This app is a major game changer for any company with corporate gifting clients and casual gift shoppers alike.
Great customer service and management. Helpful tutorials and great price for product with several options to best fit your needs. 10/10
Company provides great service and the app has streamlined our checkout process in a very valuable way.

I've been working with the team for a while now and they absolutely saved our arses and made our corporate season (2025) a magnificent success. We did about $300,000 worth of sales with just Just orders going to Send To Many last November and December. And honestly, I would really recommend working with them. They're absolutely amazing to work with.They genuinely fight for you to succeed as a merchant.

It's by far the most valuable B2B app that Shopify has on the marketplace today. And I say that full chest. It's crazy that it's not just being like slapped on every single B2B advertisement that Shopify has. So, Shopify, if you're listening, these guys know what they're doing. And this is the future of B2B because this is where businesses want to go send many gifts to all of their customers, right? And if you make it easy for people and you give them an option of, hey, I want to be able to upload this. Hey, I want to be able to do this on the front end myself, they'll go do it.

Send To Many has been a game changer for us. Our influencer team needed a way to quickly scale gifting and Send To Many was the solution. They have been extremely easy to get in contact with. They've also been so helpful when things haven't worked exactly like we expected. Overall, they're responsive, quick to address feedback and just great people to work with. 1000/10 recommend.

Allowed us to easily offer additional services and value to customers without stressing our resources. Really appreciate how we don't need to reformat our order spreadsheet before we upload it. Very knowledgable team who listened to our needs and were super helpful getting us set up!

We processed thousands of corporate gift orders this season, and Send to Many made what could’ve been an overwhelming task incredibly efficient. Creating individual shipping labels for each recipient used to be a tedious, manual process—but this app streamlined everything. What really stood out was the support. Cam guided us through setup and was always available when questions came up. Thanks to Send to Many, we saved countless hours and delivered every order smoothly. If you're handling bulk shipments, this app is a must. Thank you again!

This app takes all the pain out of uploading and managing corporate gifting orders. We frequently have corporate customers sending large numbers of bouquets to customers or flower workshop kits to remote teams. It has always been a challenge to get these orders into Shopify but Send To Many streamlines the whole process from uploading through customer billing through order management. We sent hundreds of deliveries through the app during BFCM. And for Valentine's Day, we sent dozens of influencers orders that our PR agency sent us in a spreadsheet. Took minutes to upload and manage instead of the hours we spent in the past. Even Better was really responsive and helpful in walking us through the app and making sure everything went smoothly.
Great app that solves a pain point with Shopify. Very helpful support by Cam and Mark. We think this will make a real difference for our business.
I was impressed with the most amazing support, I even got a helpful reply well after business hours when I needed help setting things up. I didn’t expect such a fast, considerate response!
Incredibly simple integration and hugely helpful with bulk order placement for influencer/gifting reciepients - a must have!
This app makes it so easy to turn a spreadsheet of orders into individual orders in Shopify-- and offers lots of control over how the orders get generated too. Highly recommend!
I dont want to have to add an address each time.
Bulk ordering couldn't be easier! Love this App!
